levels.ypp_ads: Accepted YPP channel meeting full ads/Premium revenue-share eligibility and the relevant module terms.
levels.expanded_ypp: Accepted YPP channel meeting lower creator-payment entry route plus product-specific legal and country requirements.
levels.ypp_virtual_items: YPP and separately accepted Virtual Items terms, age/identity, country and eligible video/stream rules.
levels.shopping_own: YPP plus qualifying channel or OAC exception, linked merchant and relevant audience restrictions.
levels.shopping_affiliate: YPP plus specific affiliate-country, seller, music-channel and child-directed content restrictions.
levels.not_ypp_dependent: External commercial arrangements are not automatically unlocked or blocked by YPP; platform and independent provider policies apply.

rules: All requirements are necessary research checks, not an eligibility guarantee or product approval.
An unknown minimum creator age is recorded null, not interpreted as proof that minors qualify.
Made-for-kids restrictions differ by individual content versus channel designation.
External commercial routes are not official YouTube revenue-sharing features.
Region is one gate among account standing, rights, content, age, agreements, product availability and payout conditions.
No creator's country, age, identity, payment account or audience is determined by this public matrix.
